reuse.why: Reuses the shared assertBankAccountNotLinked guard and LinkAccountBaseParams so all six providers get the flag, but copies unlinkAccount's local field reset instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block that clears account_id, bank, balances, sync source and status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the meaning of 'unlinked' now lives in two places.

placement.why: The unlink side effect is buried in a function named assert...NotLinked, which now mutates another account instead of only validating.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the replace branch and one test; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Threading one parameter through a shared guard is easy to follow, but a mutating 'assert' and a second copy of the unlink reset will drift when unlinkAccount changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked re-implements unlinkAccount's local reset (db.updateAccount with nulled bank fields) rather than splitting unlinkAccount into a local-unlink helper plus the provider call.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block is verbatim from unlinkAccount, with a comment pointing at it; it is duplicated openly, not disguised.
